title: Callvale after: an Aurora cluster with two Aurora Replicas
claim: The services write through the cluster endpoint and read through the reader endpoint of one Aurora cluster that shares one volume.
alt: After: the Fargate services send writes to the cluster endpoint and dashboard queries to the reader endpoint. The Aurora writer is in AZ 1 and two Aurora Replicas are in AZ 2 and AZ 3; all three use one cluster volume. Dev and staging use Aurora Serverless v2.

edges.label: cluster endpoint
edges.say: The services send writes to the cluster endpoint, which connects to the current primary DB instance.

edges.label: reader endpoint
edges.say: Dashboard queries use the reader endpoint, which balances connections to available Aurora Replicas.
The writer and both replicas connect to the same storage volume, which keeps six copies of the data.

edges.label: fails over
edges.say: If the writer fails, Aurora automatically fails over to an Aurora Replica.

notes: Brief 27 story pair, after (2-deep.md#decision-record, after Decision). Same cells as aurora-before; the cluster volume in row 4, the dev and staging group in row 5. Step facts: 1 aurora-cluster-endpoint-connects-to-current-primary; 2 aurora-reader-endpoint-balances-connections-not-queries; 3 aurora-adding-replicas-read-same-volume-offload and aurora-storage-six-copies-three-azs ('six copies' is its display); 4 aurora-auto-failover-to-replica. AZ 1 to AZ 3 are labels. No second Region (stage 4). Keep say and Markdown steps equal (L703).
